title: REQ · A unit test reads the real .gitignore and checks game/frontend/node_modules is covered
summary: Test proves the real ignore file covers the nested node_modules path
description: A vitest test in game/frontend/tests reads the repository-root .gitignore with node:fs and evaluates whether game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json is matched by an unanchored directory rule.
acceptance_criteria: Given the real .gitignore, when the test evaluates game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json, then it is ignored
Given a sample ignore text with only `game/node_modules/`, when evaluated for the same path, then it is not ignored

in_scope: one test file and a small pure helper

technical_constraints: Read file via node:fs readFileSync with a Node URL alias as in phaserVersionGuard.test.ts
